status: post-opening matrix decomposition frozen before endpoint readback
sample: same 4,236 matched wet-dry route x RunNumber pairs; exact-consecutive-year sensitivity prespecified
question: Which species x stop incidence processes account for rainfall-associated expansion of the active community?

quadrants.corner_expansion: wet-gain incidences from route-new species at stops inactive in dry minus the symmetric dry-loss incidences from route-lost species at stops inactive in wet
quadrants.spatial_spread: wet-gain incidences from route-existing species at stops inactive in dry minus the symmetric dry-loss incidences from route-existing species at stops inactive in wet
quadrants.taxonomic_deepening: wet-gain incidences from route-new species at stops already active in dry minus the symmetric dry-loss incidences from route-lost species at stops active in wet
quadrants.within_core_rearrangement: wet-gain incidences from route-existing species at stops already active in dry minus symmetric dry-loss incidences from route-existing species at stops active in wet

exact_identity: delta_species_stop_incidences = corner_expansion + spatial_spread + taxonomic_deepening + within_core_rearrangement for every pair

model.formula: response ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber)

secondary_synthesis: fraction of total rain-contrast incidence beta attributable to each quadrant when total beta and component sum are positive
sum of spatial-axis components = corner_expansion + spatial_spread
sum of taxonomic-axis components = corner_expansion + taxonomic_deepening

interpretation_boundary.incidence: binary acoustic species detection at a stop, not abundance
interpretation_boundary.new_or_existing: relative to the paired comparison run, not colonization or extinction
interpretation_boundary.active_or_inactive_stop: relative to the paired comparison run, not habitat creation
